transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I guess it’s about my wife. She says the late meetings and small changes in her work messages are just normal office things, but over the past year they’ve lined up too neatly. It doesn’t feel accidental to me. It feels like there’s some private signal in them, like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Are you certain that these changes in her messages are deliberate signals to you?

Yes… I mean, I know she says it’s just normal work stuff, late meetings and small wording changes. But to me, after seeing it for so long, it lines up too precisely to be random. It feels deliberate, like she’s signaling something to me that she won’t just say directly.
If someone showed you clear proof that these message changes were just routine work things, would you still believe your wife was signaling you?

I’d have a hard time accepting that, honestly. Even if someone called it routine, I’d still feel like it’s too consistent to be accidental. The late meetings, the little changes in how she writes things… after a year, it feels like there’s a message in it meant for me, something she won’t just say outright.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices when nobody’s there.
Have you become more withdrawn from other people lately?

Not really, no. I still go to my teaching sections, I keep up with my data analysis, I ride my bike, and I still meet friends for chess. The main problem is more at home, when my wife and I get stuck arguing about what her work schedule means.
Do you believe anyone besides your wife is sending you hidden messages or signs?

No, not really anyone else. It’s mainly my wife. I know she says the late meetings and those small changes in her work messages are normal office things, but they’ve lined up too precisely for too long. It feels like there’s a private signal in them meant for me, like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Do you think it is possible that you might be mistaken about your wife sending you hidden signals?

I suppose it’s possible in some abstract way. I know people can misread things. But it really doesn’t feel like that here. My wife says the late meetings and little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but over the past year they’ve lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It feels like a private signal, like she’s trying to tell me something she won’t say directly.
Do you believe your wife is having an affair?

I don’t know if I’d put it that bluntly as “an affair.” What I know is that the late meetings and the small changes in her work messages have been lining up for about a year in a way that doesn’t feel accidental. It feels like there’s some kind of private signal in them, like she’s trying to tell me something she won’t just say directly.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being put into your mind by someone else?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, my thoughts feel like my own thoughts. I haven’t had the sense that someone is putting them there.
Have you ever felt that an outside force was controlling your actions?
No, I haven’t felt like that. I make my own choices and control what I do. I’ve never had the sense some outside force was moving me or making me act.
Before this started with your wife, have you generally tended to mistrust other people’s motives?
Not really, no. I mean, I’ve had the usual doubts about people here and there, but I wouldn’t say I generally mistrusted everyone’s motives before all this.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see.
Did this belief about your wife begin very suddenly?
It wasn’t all at once, no. It’s been going on for about a year, since she started working outside the home again.
Do you believe your wife is communicating with you through ordinary work messages in a hidden but realistic way, or in some impossible or supernatural way?

Not supernatural, no. It’s not like voices or anything impossible. I mean ordinary things — her late meetings, small changes in the way her work messages come in or how they’re worded. She says it’s just normal office stuff, but over the past year it’s lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It feels like there’s a private signal in it, like she’s telling me something she won’t say directly.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually high or irritable in mood?
Not really, no. I get annoyed or stressed sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had a period where my mood was unusually high or really irritable in some out-of-character way.
Have you ever checked your wife’s phone, email, or belongings to look for evidence about this?

I haven’t really found anything definite like that. It’s more that the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages keep lining up in a way that feels too precise to be accidental. She says it’s just normal office stuff, but to me it feels like there’s some private signal in it, like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve never felt like my thoughts were being sent out where other people could hear them or know them. That’s not really what it feels like to me.
Have you directly accused your wife of being unfaithful?

I haven’t come right out and said it like that, not directly. I’ve told her that the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages don’t feel accidental to me. It’s been going on for about a year, and it feels too lined up, like there’s some private signal there about something she won’t just say.
Do you believe your wife is being sexually unfaithful to you?

I think she is, yes. I know she says the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages are just normal office things, but for about a year now they’ve lined up too precisely. It doesn’t feel accidental to me. It feels like there’s some private signal in it, like she’s trying to tell me something without saying it directly.
Have you ever followed your wife or tried to catch her with someone?
No, I haven’t followed her or tried to catch her with someone. I’ve thought about things and wondered, but I haven’t gone out and done that.
